blocks.text: Sales strategies are tactics used to convince customers to purchase your product. This might include offering discounts, running promotions, or providing excellent customer service.
Example: During Ramadan, many grocery stores in Pakistan offer special deals on food items, which encourages more people to buy in bulk.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Many Pakistani businesses increase their advertising efforts during Ramadan and Eid because people tend to shop more during these times. This is a strategic way to boost sales and make the most of the festive season.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Imagine you are starting your own business selling a product of your choice. Develop a marketing and sales strategy for your business. Consider your target market, how you will reach them, and what sales tactics you will use. Share your plan with the class.
